Saya akan generate PRISMA flow diagram berbasis teks/tabel dan menyisipkannya ke draft paper. Sebentar, saya cek dulu isi Editor-nya... 🔍Baik, saya lihat dulu Section III yang sekarang ya.Saya lihat Section III sudah ada placeholder PRISMA Flow Diagram (Fig. 2) tapi gambarnya kosong. Sekarang saya ganti dengan **text-based PRISMA flow diagram** yang rapi berbasis tabel.

Semua angkanya sudah ada di draft — saya tinggal susun ulang.

---Oke, saya sudah lihat Section III kamu. Sekarang saya masukkan **text-based PRISMA Flow Diagram** langsung ke dalamnya:

---Sudah saya usulkan! Berikut yang berubah:

---

**Yang diubah di Section III (METHODOLOGY):**

✅ Placeholder gambar PRISMA yang kosong → diganti **text-based flow diagram 4 tahap**:

```
IDENTIFICATION → SCREENING → ELIGIBILITY → INCLUDED
      858        →   621    →    143      →   50→38
```

Semua angka tetap sama dengan data asli:

| Stage | In/Out |
|---|---|
| Database search | 812 + 46 citation chasing |
| Duplicates removed | 621 screened |
| Excluded (title/abstract) | 478 |
| Full-text assessed | 143 |
| Excluded (reasons) | 93 |
| Qualitative synthesis | 50 |
| Meta-analysis | 38 |

---

Cek dulu di **Preview** ya. Kalau tampilannya sudah oke, bisa langsung **Accept**. Kalau ada yang kurang pas, bilang aja — misalnya mau format tabel Markdown biasa atau penyesuaian angka lain! 😊

arguments.title: METHODOLOGY
arguments.content:
The review followed PRISMA 2020 with a meta-analytic extension. Four design choices shaped the protocol: a deliberately narrow climate filter (Köppen A, Cwa, Cfa-warm, BSh), dual independent screening with a third adjudicator, a harmonised effect-size extraction sheet that converted heterogeneous metrics into a common ΔT and percentage-saving frame, and pre-registered subgroup analyses on wall type, orientation, and humidity regime. Two reviewers screened independently (Cohen's κ = 0.78). The PRISMA 2020 flow diagram (Fig. 2) traces the study selection process from 812 initial records to 38 studies in the quantitative synthesis.

[Figure 2: PRISMA 2020 Flow Diagram — TEXT-BASED]

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     IDENTIFICATION                                   │
│                                                                      │
│  Records identified through database searching:                      │
│    • Scopus                          n = 412                         │
│    • Web of Science Core Collection  n = 287                         │
│    • Google Scholar (top 200)        n = 113                         │
│                                 ───────────                          │
│    • Subtotal database records       n = 812                         │
│    • Records from citation chasing    n = 46                         │
│                                 ───────────                          │
│    • TOTAL RECORDS IDENTIFIED        n = 858                         │
└────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┘
                             │
                             ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         SCREENING                                    │
│                                                                      │
│  Records after duplicates removed:       n = 621                      │
│  Records screened (title + abstract):    n = 621                      │
│       │                                                              │
│       ├── Records excluded:              n = 478                      │
│       │     • Climate mismatch (non-A/Cwa/Cfa-warm/BSh)  n = 312    │
│       │     • No original empirical data                 n = 88     │
│       │     • Non-vertical greenery system               n = 78     │
│       │                                                              │
│       ▼                                                              │
│  Full-text articles sought:              n = 143                      │
│  Full-text articles not retrieved:        n = 0                       │
└────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┘
                             │
                             ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       ELIGIBILITY                                    │
│                                                                      │
│  Full-text articles assessed:            n = 143                      │
│       │                                                              │
│       ├── Articles excluded:              n = 93                      │
│       │     • No quantitative thermal/energy outcome   n = 41       │
│       │     • Simulation-only without field validation n = 37       │
│       │     • Non-eligible climate zone (confirmed)    n = 15       │
│       │                                                              │
│       ▼                                                              │
│  Studies eligible for qualitative synthesis: n = 50                   │
└────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┘
                             │
                             ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        INCLUDED                                      │
│                                                                      │
│  Studies in qualitative synthesis:        n = 50                      │
│       │                                                              │
│       ├── Excluded from meta-analysis:    n = 12                      │
│       │     (incomplete statistics, incompatible metrics)            │
│       │                                                              │
│       ▼                                                              │
│  Studies in quantitative meta-analysis:   n = 38                      │
│                                                                      │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

The largest exclusion driver—climate mismatch (312 records)—confirms that prior reviews without tropical filtering would have diluted findings with temperate and continental data. The decision to exclude 37 simulation-only papers without field validation was deliberately conservative; this is revisited in the limitations (Section V).
